mn91:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
mn91:2.1: tena kho pana samayena brahmāyu nāma brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto vīsaṃvassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn91:3.2: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
mn91:3.3: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn91:3.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn91:3.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn91:3.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn91:3.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
mn91:4.1: tena kho pana samayena brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa uttaro nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn91:4.2: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
mn91:4.3: ‘ayaṃ tāta uttara, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
mn91:4.4: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn91:4.6: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
mn91:4.7: ehi tvaṃ tāta uttara, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃ yeva saddo abbhuggato. yadi vā no tathā,
mn91:4.8: yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, yadi vā na tādiso.
mn91:4.9: tathā mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vedissāmā’ti.
mn91:5.1: yathā kathampanāhaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ jānissāmi: yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ yeva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā,
mn91:5.2: yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso yadi vā na tādiso’ti.
mn91:5.3: āgatāni kho tāta uttara, amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveyeva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā,
mn91:5.4: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
mn91:5.6: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
mn91:5.7: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
mn91:5.8: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati:
mn91:5.9: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado.
mn91:5.10: ahaṃ kho pana te tāta uttara, mantānaṃ dātā,
mn91:6.1: evaṃ bhoti kho uttaro māṇavo brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā videhesu yena bhagavā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn91:6.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn91:6.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn91:6.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
mn91:6.5: addasā kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
mn91:6.6: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati:
mn91:6.9: ‘passati kho me ayaṃ uttaro māṇavo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
mn91:6.10: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
mn91:7.1: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi. yathā addasa uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
mn91:7.2: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi parimasi. ubhopi nāsikāsotāni anumasi parimasi. kevalampi lalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
mn91:8.2: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi.
mn91:8.3: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ anubandheyyaṃ iriyāpathañcassa passeyya’nti.
mn91:8.4: atha kho uttaro māṇavo satta māsāni bhagavantaṃ anubandhi chāyāva anapāyinī.
mn91:8.5: atha kho uttaro māṇavo sattannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena videhesu yena mithilā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn91:8.6: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena mithilā yena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo etadavoca:
mn91:8.7: kacci tāta uttara, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ yeva saddo abbhuggato no aññathā,
mn91:8.8: kacci ca pana so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, no aññādiso’ti.
mn91:8.9: tathāsantaṃyeva bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā saddo abbhuggato, no aññathā,
mn91:8.10: tādisova ca bho so bhavaṃ gotamo, na aññādiso.
mn91:8.11: samannāgato ca so bho bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi.
mn91:9.1: suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo,
mn91:9.2: idampi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
mn91:9.3: heṭṭhā kho panassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāṇi.
mn91:9.4: āyatapaṇhi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.5: dīghaṅgulī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.6: mudutaḷuṇahatthapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.7: jālahatthapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.8: ussaṅkhapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.9: eṇijaṅgho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.10: ṭhitakova kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati.
mn91:9.11: kosohitavatthaguyho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.12: suvaṇṇavaṇṇo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo kañcanasannibhattaco.
mn91:9.13: sukhumacchavi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalippati.
mn91:9.14: ekekalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, ekekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni.
mn91:9.15: uddhaggalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍalāvattāni padakkhiṇāvattakajātāni.
mn91:9.16: brahmujjugatto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.17: sattussado kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.18: sīhapubbaddhakāyo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.19: citantaraṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.20: nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, yāvatakvassa kāyo tāvatakvassa vyāmo yāvatakvassa vyāmo tāvatakvassa kāyo.
mn91:9.21: samavattakkhandho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.22: rasaggasaggī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.23: sīhahanu kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.24: cattāḷīsadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.25: samadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.26: avivaradanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.27: susukkadāṭho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.28: pahūtajivho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.29: brahmassaro kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, karavīkabhāṇī.
mn91:9.30: abhinīlanetto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.31: gopakhumo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mn91:9.32: uṇṇā kho panassa bhoto gotamassa bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā.
mn91:9.33: uṇhīsasīso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo idampi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
mn91:9.34: imehi kho so bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato.
mn91:10.1: gacchanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo dakkhiṇeneva pādena paṭhamaṃ pakkamati.
mn91:10.2: so nātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, nāccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati,
mn91:10.4: na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati.
mn91:10.5: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti.
mn91:10.6: gacchato kho panassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyova iñjati. na ca kāyabalena gacchati.
mn91:10.7: avalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyeneva avaloketi.
mn91:10.8: so na uddhaṃ ulloketi. na adho oloketi.
mn91:10.9: na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañca pekkhati. tato cassa uttariṃ anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
mn91:11.1: so antaragharaṃ pavisanto na kāyaṃ unnāmeti. na kāyaṃ onāmeti. na kāyaṃ sannāmeti. na kāyaṃ vināmeti.
mn91:12.1: so nātidūre nāccāsanne āsanassa parivattati. na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati. na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.
mn91:12.2: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati. na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati.
mn91:12.3: na ca adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati. na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati.
mn91:12.4: na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upādiyitvā nisīdati.
mn91:12.5: so antaraghare nisinnova samāno nachambhati na kampati na vedhati na paritassati. achambhī akampī avedhī aparitassī vigatalomahaṃso.
mn91:12.6: vivekāvatto ca so bhavaṃ gotamo antaraghare nisinno hoti.
mn91:13.1: so pattodakaṃ patigaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti. na pattaṃ onāmeti. na pattaṃ sannāmeti. na pattaṃ vināmeti.
mn91:14.2: so na bulubulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati. na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati. na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati. hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti. patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.
mn91:14.3: so pattodakaṃ chaḍḍeti nātidūre nāccāsanne na ca vicchaḍḍayamāno.
mn91:14.4: so odanaṃ patigaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti. na pattaṃ onāmeti. na pattaṃ sannāmeti. na pattaṃ vināmeti.
mn91:14.6: byañjanaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atimāneti.
mn91:14.7: dvattikkhattuṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati.
mn91:14.8: na cassa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnaṃ kāyaṃ pavisati, na cassa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti.
mn91:14.10: rasapaṭisaṃvedī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti no ca rasarāgapaṭisaṃvedī.
mn91:14.11: aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti.
mn91:14.12: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi. yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti.
mn91:15.1: so bhuttāvī pattodakaṃ patigaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti na pattaṃ onāmeti. na pattaṃ sannāmeti. na pattaṃ vināmeti.
mn91:15.3: so na bulubulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati. na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati. hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti. patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.
mn91:15.4: so pattodakaṃ chaḍḍeti nātidūre nāccāsanne, na ca vicchaḍḍayamāno.
mn91:16.1: so bhuttāvī na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati nātidūre nāccāsanne, na ca anatthiko pattena hoti, na ca ativelānurakkhī pattasmiṃ.
mn91:17.1: so bhuttāvī muhuttaṃ tuṇhī nisīdati. na ca anumodanassa kālamatināmeti.
mn91:17.2: so bhuttāvī anumodati. na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati. na aññaṃ bhattaṃ pāṭikaṅkhati
mn91:17.3: aññadatthu dhammiyāva kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
mn91:17.4: so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati.
mn91:18.1: so nātisīghaṃ gacchati, nātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca nimuccitukāmo gacchati.
mn91:19.1: na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāye cīvaraṃ accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti, na ca accokkaṭṭhaṃ, na ca kāyasmiṃ allīnaṃ, na ca kāyasmā apakaṭṭhaṃ,
mn91:19.2: na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāyamhā vāto cīvaraṃ apavahati.
mn91:19.3: na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāye rajojallaṃ upalippati.
mn91:20.1: so ārāmagato nisīdati paññatte āsane. nisajja pāde pakkhāleti.
mn91:20.2: na ca so bhavaṃ gotamo pādamaṇḍanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn91:20.3: so pāde pakkhāletvā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn91:20.4: so neva attavyābādhāya ceteti, na paravyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāya ceteti.
mn91:20.5: attahitaṃ parahitaṃ ubhayahitaṃ sabbalokahitameva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti.
mn91:21.1: so ārāmagato parisatiṃ dhammaṃ deseti na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti. na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti.
mn91:21.2: aññadatthu dhammiyāva kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
mn91:21.3: aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato kho panassa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati.
mn91:21.4: vissaṭṭho ca viññeyyo ca mañju ca savanīyo ca bindu ca avisārī ca gambhīro ca ninnādī ca.
mn91:21.5: yathāparisaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sarena viññāpeti. na cassa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati.
mn91:21.6: te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamanti apalokayamānāyeva avijahantā bhāvena.
mn91:22.1: addasāma kho mayaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gacchantaṃ. addasāma ṭhitaṃ. addasāma anantaragharaṃ pavisantaṃ addasāma antaraghare nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ. addasāma bhuttāviṃ anumodantaṃ. addasāma ārāmaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ārāmagataṃ nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ. addasāma ārāmagataṃ parisatiṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ.
mn91:22.2: ediso ca ediso ca bho so bhavaṃ gotamo, tato ca bhiyyo’ti.
mn91:23.1: evaṃ vutte brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
mn91:23.5: appeva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ samāgaccheyyāma, appeva nāma siyā kocideva kathāsallāpo’ti.
mn91:24.1: atha kho bhagavā videhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena mithilā tadavasari.
mn91:24.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā mithilāyaṃ viharati makhādevambavane.
mn91:24.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto mithilāyaṃ viharati makhādevambavane.
mn91:24.5: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn91:24.6: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā,
mn91:24.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti .
mn91:24.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn91:24.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
mn91:25.1: atha kho ෙmathileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn91:26.1: assosi kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo, ‘samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito mithilaṃ anuppatto, mithilāyaṃ viharati makhādevambavane’ti.
mn91:26.2: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo sambahulehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ yena makhādevambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn91:26.3: atha kho brahmāyuno brāhmaṇassa avidūre ambavanassa etadahosi:
mn91:26.4: ‘na kho metaṃ patirūpaṃ yohaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyya’nti.
mn91:26.5: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ māṇavakaṃ āmantesi:
mn91:26.6: ‘ehi tvaṃ māṇavaka, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha,
mn91:26.7: brahmāyu bho gotama brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
mn91:26.9: brahmāyu bho gotama, brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto vīsaṃvassasatiko jātiyā tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn91:26.10: yāvatā kho brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati
mn91:26.17: evaṃ bhoti kho so māṇavako brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn91:26.18: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so māṇavako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn91:26.19: brahmāyu bho gotama, brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
mn91:26.21: brahmāyu bho gotama, brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo …pe… lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn91:26.22: yāvatā bho brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti, brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati
mn91:27.1: atha kho so māṇavako yena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn91:28.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
mn91:28.2: addasā kho sā parisā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ,
mn91:28.3: disvāna atha naṃ okāsamakāsi yathā taṃ ñātassa yasassino.
mn91:28.4: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca:
mn91:29.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn91:29.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn91:29.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi.
mn91:29.4: addasā kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
mn91:29.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati,
mn91:29.7: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
mn91:30.2: ‘passati kho me ayaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
mn91:30.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
mn91:30.5: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi. yathā addasa brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
mn91:30.6: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi parimasi, ubhopi nāsikāsotāni anumasi parimasi. kevalampi lalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
mn91:30.7: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi.
mn91:32.3: kinnu kho ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ puccheyyaṃ
mn91:32.8: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ samparāyikaññeva atthaṃ puccheyya’nti.
mn91:32.9: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi.
mn91:33.1: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi.
mn91:34.1: evaṃ vutte, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati. pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati. nāmañca sāveti:
mn91:35.1: atha kho sā parisā acchariyabbhutacittā jātā ahosi:
mn91:35.2: ‘acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
mn91:35.3: yatra hi nāmāyaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo ñāto yasassī evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karissatī’ti.
mn91:35.4: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn91:35.5: ‘alaṃ brāhmaṇa, uṭṭhaha, nisīda tvaṃ sake āsane, yato te mayi cittaṃ pasanna’nti.
mn91:35.6: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhahitvā sake āsane nisīdi.
mn91:36.1: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ:
mn91:36.3: kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
mn91:36.4: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
mn91:36.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
mn91:36.7: evamevaṃ brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa tasmiññeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi,
mn91:36.8: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.
mn91:36.9: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo, pattadhammo, viditadhammo, pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn91:37.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya. paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn91:37.3: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn91:37.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ.
mn91:37.5: adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
mn91:37.7: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn91:38.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
mn91:38.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn91:38.4: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn91:39.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena videhesu cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn91:39.2: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi.
mn91:39.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn91:39.6: paṇḍito bhikkhave, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo, paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
mn91:39.7: brahmāyu bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
mn91:39.9: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
